sense: to pay attention to a sound

pins.definition: To pay attention to a sound or to what someone is saying.
To pay attention to audio such as music, the radio, or a lecture.
To pay attention to a sound or to someone speaking.

situation: An old man sitting alone in a dim room tilts his head toward a glowing radio on the table.
subject: paying attention to a sound
brief: An elderly man sits in a dark, quiet room with his eyes closed and his ear turned sharply toward an old wooden radio, whose small dial emits a warm amber glow. Every line of his face and posture concentrates entirely on the tiny speaker cloth, showing intense physical absorption in the sound.
